caption: The drawing features a rectangular grid composed of six squares arranged in two columns and three rows, each square containing a floral pattern. The main pattern inside each square consists of a large, red, flower-like shape with wavy edges, bordered by a thin, pink outline. Surrounding each red flower are four sets of shapes, each set containing a green leaf and a red petal with a pink patterned half-circle behind it, all radiating outward diagonally from the central flower. The background of the grid is a very pale beige or off-white. Above the grid, two fabric swatches are present: the left swatch is green with a repeating yellow and darker green pattern, and the right swatch is white with a red, irregular dot-and-squiggle pattern. The entire composition sits on an off-white background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
